The wiki publishes original explanations and a limited factual reference, not the game or a substitute for its creative content.

== Acceptable evidence ==
Short entity names, numeric or boolean mechanics facts, source hashes, and precise section/key identifiers can support a curated entry. Explain uncertainty and write descriptions yourself.

Source paths must be relative to the installation. Never publish user-profile paths, usernames from saves, authentication details, or private server settings.

== Keep private ==
Do not publish game binaries, audio, fonts, maps, save data, full configuration files, localization descriptions, dialogue, tool exports, or decompiled source. Do not paste a full paragraph merely to prove that a number appears in it. Cite the identifier and summarize the fact instead.

Pictures require a separate rights review before publication. A reserved File title or server-only storage is not permission to reproduce artwork. Only an operator may import an individually approved picture with attribution; public web uploads remain disabled, and image bytes never belong in the repository.

Owning a copy of the game does not by itself grant permission to redistribute its contents. Local analysis tools do not change that rule. Stop and seek permission when a proposed contribution falls outside this narrow policy.

== Evidence is not certainty ==
Distinguish what a source says from what the game does. A name may be unused, obsolete, or reserved for content not currently accessible. A shared label does not establish combat behavior.

Corrections should preserve useful attribution and explain the changed conclusion. Existing live wiki edits are not automatically replaced by repository seed imports.
